integrity: The proof is deductive. The semisimple shift decomposition is taken from the inspected primary preprint; infinite entropy of each nontrivial compact-Lie-alphabet full shift is proved directly by separated sets. No finite experiment or search failure is treated as proof of an infinite statement or of novelty.
scientific_limitations: The theorem gives a one-way obstruction: it does not assert that an abelian stable image has finite entropy, and it does not classify the entropy of the abelian shift-type part. The originality comparison is limited to inspected public sources and searches.
title: Finite entropy forces an abelian stable image for shadowing compact-group endomorphisms
